messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。美國黃金價格（如黃金期貨或現貨）每天都會隨著交易時間、供需變化以及全球經濟事件而波動。若您想知道今天的精確價格，建議參考以下可靠來源：

| 資料來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|----------|------|------|
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 具備全球金融市場報導 |
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 專門報導貴金屬價格與市場趨勢 |
| **NYMEX（CME Group）** | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/energy/commodity-futures.html | 黃金期貨合約官方交易所 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 提供即時圖表與技術分析工具 |

如果您需要即時價格，請直接訪問上述網站或使用其 API（若您有開發需求）。若您想了解黃金價格的歷史走勢、影響因素或投資策略，我也很樂意協助解說。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). We need to provide the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide a typical price or say we can't fetch live data. We can also mention typical sources. We should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Provide typical range.
